name: garmin-connect
description: Ask about your Garmin sleep, HRV, training and activity data.
long_description:
Reads health, sleep, training and activity data from your own Garmin Connect account: sleep stages and score, overnight HRV, Body Battery, stress, SpO2, steps, weigh-ins, activities with per-lap splits, and a one-call morning briefing.

Sign-in happens once. Enter your Garmin email and password below; if your account uses two-step verification, Garmin emails you a code and Claude will ask for it in the conversation. After that a saved token keeps you signed in for about a year.

This uses the same private API the Garmin Connect app uses, because Garmin's official API is only issued under a commercial partner agreement. It is unsupported by Garmin and reads your data only.

email.title: Garmin email
email.description: The email address you sign in to Garmin Connect with.

password.title: Garmin password
password.description: Used once to obtain a token, then kept only by Claude's secure storage.

enable_writes.title: Allow changes to my Garmin data
enable_writes.description: Off by default. When on, Claude may rename activities and log weight or hydration. Nothing can be deleted either way.
